symbols.name: Binding
symbols.summary: Gets the finalized collection contract, provider binding and effective policies.

symbols.name: Catalog
symbols.summary: Gets the immutable process startup catalog used by this runtime.

symbols.name: Resources
symbols.summary: Gets exact process-level admission and memory accounts shared by all collections.

symbols.name: CollectionResources
symbols.summary: Gets this collection's child accounts within applicable provider and process ceilings.

symbols.name: Tasks
symbols.summary: Gets the lifetime tracker for actually unfinished admitted work and native tails.

symbols.name: Time
symbols.summary: Gets the host observation clock used for validity, deadlines and bounded waits.

symbols.name: Access
symbols.summary: Gets bounded complete-provider access and lazy initialization for this collection.

symbols.name: PayloadPipeline
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the code-composed staged-payload behavior pipeline before the handle is exposed.

symbols.name: Transforms
symbols.summary: Gets or sets trusted persisted payload transformations resolved for this collection.

symbols.name: Hot
symbols.summary: Gets strict local retained representations, or null when local hot retention is disabled.

symbols.name: Observations
symbols.summary: Gets the preallocated collection observation slot without introducing key-specific metric labels.

symbols.name: TransferObservers
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the code-composed observers whose scopes end at actual stream completion.

symbols.name: Enabled
symbols.summary: Gets whether both global and collection-level advanced cache storage are enabled.
